plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog pp. 235-236 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AA-T in History. 'Major & US History' maps to major (by analogy with 'Major + US/CA Politics' → major); 'Major, List A/B' maps to major; 'US/CA Politics' maps to core. MATH 13/MATH 15 choice codes first-listed MATH 13 (4 units); the printed '15-20' range reflects the 3-unit MATH 15 alternative — documented in choice_note. The ANTHR 1/ANTHR 1L vs BIOL 10 choice is a paired lecture+lab (4 units) versus BIOL 10 (4 units); code ANTHR 1. ENGL 5 and COMM 5 both require ENGL 1A — the ENGL 5/COMM 5 choice codes ['ENGL 1A']. Footnote 1 (HIST 7A/7B): must be taken at College of Alameda to count for the CSU GE Area. Computed total 62. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
